title: tephrocactus neoglomeratus var. atratospinus
intro: Tephrocactus neoglomeratus var. atratospinus, commonly known as the black-spined clustering cactus, is a species of cactus in the family of Cactaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in medicine due to its potential health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Tephrocactus neoglomeratus var. atratospinus include its ability to act as an antimicrobial and antifungal agent, making it useful for treating infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
